race.description: Benstud Standardbreds Up To Nr45 Conditioned Trotters Hcp
race.comment: LOCHINVAR SON (5) had been racing in great heart then added to the list last start when he finished second over 2138m at this track, beaten 9 metres. That latest effort is good enough to put him right in the finish. ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (6) had put together a string of strong performances then was again in fine form last start when she finished third over 2138m at this track, beaten 9 metres. Meets a similar line up so she can pick up that long overdue win. CROOKWELL EYES (7) was out of the money two runs ago then broke and finished eighth last start over 2138m at this track, coming home 40 metres from the winner. Only needs to get things right to be in the money. BLACK VIPER (11) was out of the money two starts ago then things went wrong last start when he broke and finished a distant tenth over 2138m at this track. Meets a similar line up so if he behaves a big run is likely.
